name: Methylenedioxybenzylpiperazine
summary: MDBZP, also known as 1-(3,4-methylenedioxybenzyl)piperazine or as piperonylpiperazine, is a chemical compound of the benzylpiperazine family related to benzylpiperazine (BZP). MDBZP has been sold as a designer drug and has even been found as an ingredient in street Ecstasy pills.

uses.text: MDBZP has been sold as a designer drug and has even been found as an ingredient in street Ecstasy pills.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it specifically. Related piperazines such as BZP can cause anxiety, headache, nausea, a racing heart, sleeplessness and, in some cases, seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它本身所知甚少。BZP 等相關哌嗪類可能引起焦慮、頭痛、噁心、心跳過快、失眠，有時還會引發癲癇。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它本身所知甚少。BZP 等相关哌嗪类可能引起焦虑、头痛、恶心、心跳过快、失眠，有时还会引发癫痫。

fact.en: MDBZP is also called piperonylpiperazine, after piperonal, a compound with a sweet cherry and vanilla scent used in perfumes.
fact.zh: MDBZP 又稱胡椒基哌嗪，名稱來自胡椒醛，這是一種帶有櫻桃與香草甜香、用於香水的化合物。
fact.zhHans: MDBZP 又称胡椒基哌嗪，名称来自胡椒醛，这是一种带有樱桃与香草甜香、用于香水的化合物。
